name: Thandiwe Nkosi
bio:
Thandiwe's journey into motorsport catering started unexpectedly after a family friend involved in a local racing team needed help managing their food services. Before that, she spent years honing her culinary skills in various restaurants across Johannesburg, developing a keen eye for detail and a passion for delivering high-quality meals under pressure. 

In her role as catering manager, Thandiwe is known for her meticulous planning and unwavering commitment to food safety and hygiene. She believes that a well-fed team is a successful team, and she strives to create a positive and energetic atmosphere in the paddock through her delicious and nutritious offerings. Her goal is to build up the experience to become a recognized name in motorsport catering.

What sets Thandiwe apart is her ability to blend traditional South African flavors with international cuisine, creating unique and memorable dining experiences for everyone involved. Her boerewors rolls are legendary among those who have worked with her.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled natural hair with subtle grey highlights.
physical.description: A stout woman with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Always has a pot of rooibos tea brewing.
Secretly practices her knife skills while listening to motorsport podcasts.
